additional_info.subject: Charging failed to start at connector 1 - 170000127
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
There is a problem with the connector 1 on the charger with sn 170000127. We have seen on our backend multiple sessions with timeout error at start on this connector.  The other connectors 2 and 3 are charging well.
Could you please check in logs and see what can cause charging issues on this connector and how can be fixed?
Here you can check on this timeframe from our logs the latest session with error:

BaseUnitService::
startCharging
Charging will terminate automatically if not started by the charger in 120 seconds.

BaseUnitService::
startCharging
Charging request on connector 1 has been ACCEPTED.

onHeartbeat

10/6/2025, 05:02:31 AM,399

Ocpp16MessageReceiver::
onStatusNotification
Responding: StatusNotificationResponseMessage{}
